scope: Selected grammar-supported classification conventions in the strict differences

negative-particle-class.reason: אין is retained as a negative particle rather than the reference adverb label.

adjective-noun-class.reason: Adjectival/ordinal form versus noun use is an annotation-level distinction at the explicitly selected positions; other supplied features must still match.
sources: Jastrow, חסיד, entry 9536; Levy, סרבן, entry 13322
